<div class="card-body">
'''Narrow Escape''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">九死に一生</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値＞２の反乱軍がいる位置カードで、戦闘が始まった直後なら、そこにいる自分のキャラクターを全員移動させることにより（移動コストは通常どおり）、戦闘をキャンセルできる。全員を移動させられる場合にしか使用できない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-98o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">戦闘時、外壁破損の際、あるいは保安上の判断で、ブラスト・ドアは区画を封鎖する。厚いドアはブラスター・ライフルの銃火を寄せ付けない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' A narrow escape.

'''Card text:''' Use just after a battle is initiated at a site where a Rebel of ability > 2 is present. Cancel the battle by moving all of your characters there away, using Force as usual. Use only if all of them can move.

'''Lore:''' Blast doors seal off compartments in battle, when the hull is breached, or for security. Thick doors stop blaster-rifle fire.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese may be used only if all of those characters can move.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Narrow Escape]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
